# Wharf 0.11.0 research

## Scope

Session 11 expands the proven one-task path into a deterministic,
work-conserving scheduler with an explicit trial limit and observable
lifecycle state.

## Decisions

- Sort admission by stable attempt ID before scheduling.
- Bound active work by the scheduler concurrency limit and total starts by
  the trial limit; preparation/build `B` remains owned by image preparation.
- Bank successful logical-attempt IDs immediately and skip later duplicate
  attempts.
- Record lifecycle transitions through an injectable event sink.
- Mark pending work cancelled without admitting new work after cancellation.

## Deferred

Infrastructure retry classification, phase-specific resource limits,
timeouts, and restart recovery remain Sessions 12 and 13.
